result.title: EgoHand: Monocular 3D Hand Reconstruction from Egocentric Video
result.comment: Authors are listed alphabetically. Project leads are Chao-Yeh Chen, Tiffany Chen, and Umar Iqbal
result.summary: We introduce EgoHand, a monocular 3D hand reconstruction model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on egocentric video. Central to our approach is the curation of a high-quality training corpus of 14 million images, combining synthetic data, in-the-wild video, and multi-camera motion capture to balance scene diversity and supervision quality. The model adopts SOMA-Hand as its parametric representation and processes 2D hand crops with a transformer encoder, incorporating camera cues and an auxiliary 2D branch to improve geometric consistency and image alignment. Zero-shot evaluations on HOT3D, ARCTIC, and H2O demonstrate strong out-of-domain generalization, with lower joint-position, root-translation, and acceleration errors than competing baselines at an inference latency of approximately 9.69 ms. A blinded user preference study further shows that participants favor EgoHand's reconstructed hand poses over those from Apple EgoDex and Ropedia Xperience-10M. We release the EgoHand model and source code under the OpenMDW license, allowing free commercial use of the model.

AI.brief_summary: EgoHand 提出一个单目第一视角视频的 3D 手部重建模型，核心是构建约 1400 万张图像的高质量训练语料，并用 SOMA-Hand 参数化表示结合 transformer 编码器、相机线索与辅助 2D 分支来提升几何一致性与对齐。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属于几何重建/姿态估计任务，不涉及 VLM 推理中的 latent 状态、证据获取或停止决策，也未提供可迁移到 LVR 推理状态表示与贡献分配的线索，故排除。
